title: machaeranthera shastensis var. latifolia
intro: Machaeranthera shastensis var. latifolia, commonly known as Shasta false goldenrod, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may help reduce pain and inflammation, and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Machaeranthera shastensis var. latifolia include soothing and calming effects, which may help alleviate anxiety and stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant are still being studied, but it is known to contain sesquiterpene lactones, which have been shown to exhibit antimicrobial and antitumor activities.
